course_name_original: Història de la Ciència i la Tecnologia (Història)

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to correctly use basic scientific and technical language.
Be able to relate historical scenarios with scientific discoveries and technological developments.
Be able to understand the impacts of technological research on current society.
Be able to generate a respectful attitude towards human and natural values.
Be able to analyze the main scientific and technological events.
Be able to analyze the impacts of science and technology on current society, taking into account gender perspectives.
Be able to analyze from an epistemological and semantic point of view the set of scientific and technological issues and developments.
Be able to have a clear concept of the origin and construction of the main theories and their technological application.
Be able to understand the role of science and technology in daily life, as well as their contribution to improving people's quality of life.

Be able to understand the tentative and evolutionary nature of scientific laws and theories, avoiding dogmatic positions to better appreciate the importance of perspectives and approaches to technological progress.
Know how to assess the problems that technological development can generate and how they can contribute to the success of sustainability and healthy lifestyles.
Recognize the main challenges faced by the development of science and technology in current society.

syllabus_topics: BLOCK I: HISTORY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
2.2. Traditions and scientific change in the 17th century
2.3. Science in the Enlightenment and the beginnings of the Industrial Revolution
BLOCK II: PHILOSOPHY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
4.1. Nature and reality of scientific practice
4.5. The evolutionary vision and epistemological anarchism
TOPIC 5. Truth and rationality in science
BLOCK III: CURRENT CHALLENGES OF SCIENCE. (ACADEMIC WORKS)
7.4. Experimentation with animals and human beings
teaching_methods: Tutorials for theoretical and practical advice
